items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:83:1
items.html: Mochin of nursing in the middle NHY at the time of birth: For, for the sake of the Mochin of nursing, a second coupling of AVI is made, on the discernment of the screen of phase one, which is from the discernment of their middle vessels, that is, from the discernment of the Partzuf of nursing of AVI themselves. And this coupling is made at the time of birth, before he is born and descends to his place, as above, page 1128, the passage beginning “in her belly.” Study it there well.
